title: Compute brief — 15 September 2026
description: Bell × Saskatchewan MOU paths to 1.2 GW AI Fabric (+900 MW BYOP). Texas holds: 58481 still no Order Adopting (item 217); 59336 written Order still pending. Silicon Tape confirm day — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69; 69 confirms, 0 ticks.
og_kicker: Canada 1.2 GW path; Texas still gated
lede: Canada posts the clearest overnight conversion print while Texas stays on the audit clock. Bell Canada and Saskatchewan announced a non-binding MOU on 14 Sep to expand Bell AI Fabric by up to 900 MW of phased BYOP capacity on top of the 300 MW Sherwood path already drawing from the provincial grid — a named route to a 1.2 GW Canadian AI hub, still gated by customers, permits and commercial close. On the US grid side, PUCT Project 58481 (§25.194) still shows no stamped Order Adopting through Interchange item 217 (14 Sep public comment only), and Howard–Solstice (59336) remains press-approved without a written Order visible. Batch Zero verification RFIs keep running toward the ~Sep 23 response clock and Dec 10 reports. The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged across 69 re-read list prints.
